rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:1582:obj:0: Bring 1 ⟦E1⟧, 5 ⟦E2⟧ and 5 Embossed Leather Cloaks to ⟦E4⟧ in ⟦E5⟧.
rows.quest:1582:details:0: We in ⟦E5⟧, especially we craftsman, are quite busy. Young adventurers are eager to test themselves in the wilderness, and are in constant need of supplies.
rows.quest:1582:details:1: If you can help me fill my orders of leather goods, then perhaps I can teach you an advanced leatherworking technique.
rows.quest:1582:completion:0: Yes, these are good pieces. You have a skilled hand and an eye for detail. Your future as a leatherworker is promising.
rows.quest:1582:completion:1: Here, ⟦2⟧. Let me show you the pattern to make the ⟦E6⟧.
rows.quest:2847:details:0: ⟦3⟧, you're becoming quite skilled as a leatherworker! I know some patterns you might be interested in... Wild Leather armor! Wild Leather taps into the potent and chaotic properties of wildvines, found in areas of lush vegetation and on some of the creatures there. The armor made using it is second to none for people of your skill, guaranteed.
rows.quest:2847:details:1: I'll teach this to you, but you'll be working for me for a while. The first cost is simply ten pieces of thick leather. After this, we'll talk specifics.
rows.quest:2847:progress:0: Like I said, you'll be working for me while you learn about Wild Leather armor. Because wildvines are both potent and chaotic, it yields a random but strong benefit to the already strong armor you will be making. This knowledge, however, was not easy for me to come by.⟦4⟧⟦5⟧The initial cost to begin this process is ten pieces of thick leather.⟦6⟧⟦7⟧Once that is done, we'll get to the work you need to do in order to obtain the patterns.

rows.quest:5146:progress:0: Making this kind of leather-based armor requires patience and dedication. Once you have cast your lot with the elements, there is no turning your back on them. Bring me proof of your worthiness, and we'll get started.
rows.quest:5146:completion:0: You've cast your lot, and the elements accept you. Once I have finished my tutelage, you shall command the will to craft the finest of leather garbs.
rows.quest:5146:completion:1: To train in the art for the future, simply speak to me and I will make available any knowledge that you have yet to commit as yours.
rows.quest:5148:obj:0: Bring a ⟦E35⟧ and a ⟦E36⟧ to ⟦E50⟧ in ⟦E51⟧.
rows.quest:5148:obj:1: Completing this quest will give you access to the ⟦E32⟧ arts.
rows.quest:5148:obj:2: The completion of this quest will prevent you from learning ⟦E30⟧ and ⟦E31⟧; be sure this is the path you wish to follow before doing so.
rows.quest:5148:details:0: To learn tribal leatherworking demands an understanding of how primal nature truly is; I know that you have already mastered the art of making wild leather armor, and I am willing to complete your training.
rows.quest:5148:details:1: Know this, ⟦65⟧: by choosing this path you agree never to learn dragonscale or elemental leatherworking; there is only room for practice of one of the three arts. Furthermore, bring to me the finest samples of your wild leather armor. From there, we will begin your mastery.
rows.quest:5148:progress:0: Nature is a force that must be appeased before you hope to learn how to bend its will into your leather garments. Bring me your offering to this force, and I will make sure you are heard.
rows.quest:5148:completion:0: You've given your finest offerings, and nature will soon permit you to bend her to your will. Once I have finished my tutelage, your work will be a force of nature unto itself.
rows.quest:5148:completion:1: To train in the art for the future, simply speak to me and I will make available any knowledge that you have yet to commit as yours.
